answer: A new identity enters through one slow inlet and earns no weight until it matures. Its 60-credit stake stays frozen 14 days while a daily cipher check proves the same key controls it, so fresh accounts cannot vote or claim rewards. After two verified tasks, the pulse of steady activity unlocks full weight. Maturation rental fails: a rented account fails the cipher check and refreezes. The k-th fake still costs a new 60-credit lock plus 14 days, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 60 once.
